summary.text: This resolution sets forth two articles of impeachment against Secretary of Defense Pete Hegseth for high crimes and misdemeanors on charges of (1) murder and conspiracy to murder, and (2) reckless and unlawful handling of classified information.

title: Impeaching Peter B. Hegseth, Secretary of Defense of the United States, for high crimes and misdemeanors.
